card.name: Small counts before time or frequency units
card.fires_on: Small number words or digits (1 to 4, "two") that count occasions, ordinal positions or time spans, as in "two weeks later" or "3 times per week". Also fires on ordinal digits such as 1st or 3rd.

modes.label: Counts of times or weeks
modes.description: A small number or "two" just before weeks, months or times in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: followed by 80 mg<< two>> weeks later (Day 15).

modes.label: Ordinal positions
modes.description: A digit starting an ordinal such as 1st, 3rd or 2nd in a ranking or numbered series.
modes.example: a race having 2, 3, 4, 5, etc. contestants, and we can speak of the contestants as having come <<1>>st, 2nd, 3

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying "two" or "three" as a small count, and away from words like "-part" or "-step".
card.plain: It marks a small number like two, three or four that is about to be followed by a unit such as weeks or times.
